The selected pages of this section cover icy danger spots, dawn and dusk glare, night driving precautions, freeway planning, entering, driving, emergency stops and exiting, and the emergency procedures for blowouts, lost wheels, brake and steering failure, wheels off the pavement, passing conflicts, oncoming vehicles, a stuck accelerator, skids, fire and breakdowns; they teach night driving, freeway driving and emergency procedures and say nothing about any examination; they state no exam name, question count, passing standard, format or time limit.

The run scope names the Hawaii Department of Transportation as the handbook issuer and the twenty twenty-three printing as the edition, but these pages carry no page-bound issuer or edition statement, so part A asserts no issuer or edition fact of its own.

Question count, passing standard, format and time limit for the class three knowledge test are not stated anywhere in this manual; every official exam fact stays unknown in this envelope and is never guessed.

Corpus note: these procedures are stable teaching content printed in this twenty twenty-three edition with no annual-rewrite signal on these pages.
